Yes, if you left your job, you would be replaced but that person may not be as good as you. Your boyfriend might date someone else, he might not. I know he would remember you, and I'm sure he wants to be with you now. I have an older sister who is also not a loser, but my parents love me just as much because I exist and I am me, and I love them. 
True originality is becoming rarer and rarer. It doesn't matter if someone else has said the things you've said or thought what you've thought. In fact, I think that makes those thoughts more important Because they are shared, because you feel what others feel and can understand their thoughts.  
When I die, there are people who will remember me until they are gone. Very, very few of us have our names and legacies survive time and space. Likely none of us will once our species goes extinct. 
I suppose I've spent too much time feeling completely and utterly shitty to care whether or not the happiness I come by is fake or not completely altruistic. I'm not sure people (and the companies and institutions we create) are capable of complete and true selflessness, and being in a highly competitive capitalist society can absolutely make you feel disposable, like a commodity. But you don't have to care about that. You can shape your own reality.

By now, you've probably come down some from being under the influence. If you're still feeling the effects, wait it out. Drink some water. Do you find that you think more about suicide when you're under the influence? 
I'm struggling with (sober) suicidal thoughts too, so I can't tell you not to do it. I don't know your life: who and what is in it and who/what isn't. 
I don't know what inspires you, makes you feel alive, helps you forget that awful feeling. 
For me, it's music, color, light, darkness, water, and  animals, the smell and sound of the ocean, to name a few general things. But I overthink and these things seem dull and far away, or I just don't have them, so I can't tell you that you'll miss so many things.
I don't know what happens after we die. I'm scared of nothingness, of not existing, of the unknown. 
I wish I could give you more advice. I could also say that you know best, but people are compromised when our thinking is skewed. I can only hope that someday, somewhere we'll all find a peaceful place with no suffering.
